item.title: Show HN: Counterbranch - See how your PR changes access control (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description:
Hi, we just released Counterbranch as a GitHub Action (alpha) and are looking for feedback.

The action scans your codebase looking for unintended changes to authorization. This can happen in custom code, endpoints, guards, rbac, abac, policy-as-code files, etc. and can lead to broken access control or data exposure.

The scanner doesn't use LLMs and is blazing fast. The results show up as a comment on each pull request so you can maintain and improve authz for any volume of human and agentic coders.
